front: Overwhelm a creature with a sudden random urge if it fails a Will save. Roll 1d4 for the effect.
back:
Roll 1d4 on a failed save (worse on crit fail):
1 Dance: 1 round, -5 ft status penalty to Speeds (-10 on crit fail).
2 Sing: first action next turn must be Perform a song (crit fail: all actions).
3 Support: first action next turn is to prepare to Aid a nearby creature's Perform check; next reaction only to Aid it (crit fail: all actions).
4 Give away wealth: first action next turn Interact to pull out a nonmagical valuable, then Release it; if none, apologize (crit fail: apologize for rest of turn).
